Rendering - Voxel.Wiki
Rendering While rendering voxels appears easy at a glance ("they're just cubes!"), there are actually many, many, trade-offs one has to take into account, mainly depending on the intended visual style and scale of the individual voxels. Ultimately it depends on what your goals are; try not to set them too lofty!
